# 2025–26 New Taipei Kings season

The 2025–26 New Taipei Kings season is the franchise's 5th season, its second season in the Taiwan Professional Basketball League (TPBL). On July 5, 2025, the Kings announced that Ryan Marchand left the team for career decision. On July 9, the Kings hired John Patrick as their new head coach. The Kings also participated in 2025–26 East Asia Super League as the 2025 TPBL champion.
